description: Math expressions (InDesign 2025 and later): add a MathML expression to a page, list the document's expressions, edit an expression's MathML, size or colour (Edit MathML), and set the document defaults for size, colour and whether EPUB export writes MathML or SVG (Export Math Objects, 2026). Takes MathML, not LaTeX

color.description: add, edit, settings: colour of the expression: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

exportAsMathML.description: settings: EPUB export writes math objects as MathML (true) or SVG (false); InDesign 2026

id.description: edit: the math object id (from list)

mathml.description: add, edit: the expression as a MathML <math> element

x.description: add: left edge in mm from the page's left (default 0)

y.description: add: top edge in mm from the page's top (default 0)

name: manage_math_objects
title: Manage Math Objects
